The large reduction in 'Income Tax Payable' is unusual and needs clarification - it may reflect an accounting adjustment rather than a genuine improvement in tax efficiency.

The significant net loss in Q4 2017, combined with increases in 'Other Liabilities' and minor sales growth, outweigh the modest gains in asset expansion and cost control. The decreased Income Tax Payable requires greater scrutiny. The ratio analysis highlights the dramatic deterioration in net profitability.
